item.title: People Power Party Nominates Lawyer Yun Yong-geun as Candidate for Gongju·Buyeo·Cheongyang By-election (국민의힘, 충남 공주·부여·청양 보선 후보에 윤용근 변호사)
item.description:
People Power Party Nominates Lawyer Yun Yong-geun as Candidate for Gongju·Buyeo·Cheongyang By-election (국민의힘, 충남 공주·부여·청양 보선 후보에 윤용근 변호사 )

The People Power Party announced on the 12th that it has nominated lawyer Yun Yong-geun as its candidate for the Gongju·Buyeo·Cheongyang National Assembly by-election. This comes five days after former National Assembly Vice Speaker Chung Jin-suk withdrew his candidacy application. (국민의힘은 12일 충남 공주·부여·청양 국회의원 보궐선거 후보로 윤용근 변호사를 공천했다고 밝혔다. 정진석 전 국회 부의장이 후보 신청을 철회한 지 닷새 만이다.)

The People Power Party's Nomination Management Committee stated that after conducting a primary election among candidates in the Gongju·Buyeo·Cheongyang region through party member electoral college voting (50%) and general public opinion polling (50%), lawyer Yun was selected as the candidate. Candidate Yun competed in the primary against Sohn Jung-im, Vice Chair of the party's Finance Committee, and former Office of the Prime Minister official Yoon Min-ah. (국민의힘 공천관리위원회는 이날 공주·부여·청양 지역의 공천 신청자들을 대상으로 당원 선거인단 투표(50%), 일반 국민 여론조사(50%) 방식으로 경선한 결과, 윤 변호사가 후보로 결정됐다고 밝혔다. 윤 후보는 경선에서 소정임 당 재정위원회 부위원장, 윤민아 전 국무총리실 사무관과 경쟁했다.)

Candidate Yun, who is from Buyeo, graduated from Buyeo Jangam Elementary School, Buyeo Middle School, and Buyeo High School. He later studied law at Chungnam National University and passed the bar exam (48th round), working as a lawyer thereafter. Until recently, he served as the party district committee chair for Jungwon-gu, Seongnam, Gyeonggi Province, and was appointed as the party's media spokesperson under the leadership of Chairman Jang Dong-hyuk. For this reason, he is classified as a close associate of Chairman Jang. (부여 출신인 윤 후보는 부여 장암초, 장암중, 부여고를 졸업했다. 이후 충남대 법학과에 진학해 사법시험(48회) 합격 후 변호사로 활동했다. 최근까지 국민의힘 경기 성남 중원구 당협위원장을 지냈고, 장동혁 지도부 체제에서 당 미디어대변인으로 임명됐다. 이 때문에 장 대표의 측근으로 분류된다.)

The Gongju·Buyeo·Cheongyang National Assembly by-election was triggered by former Democratic Party lawmaker Park Soo-hyun's candidacy for the South Chungcheong Province governor election. The Democratic Party has nominated lawyer Kim Young-bin. (공주·부여·청양 국회의원 보궐선거는 더불어민주당 박수현 전 의원이 충남지사 선거 출마로 열리게 됐다. 민주당에선 김영빈 변호사를 공천했다.)

item.title: Park Hyung-joon: “Did Cartier fall from the sky?” Jeon Jae-soo: “Why aren’t you selling LCT?” (박형준 “까르띠에 하늘서 떨어졌냐” 전재수 “엘시티 왜 안파나”)
item.description:
Park Hyung-joon: “Did Cartier fall from the sky?” Jeon Jae-soo: “Why aren’t you selling LCT?” (박형준 “까르띠에 하늘서 떨어졌냐” 전재수 “엘시티 왜 안파나” )

In the first televised debate for Busan mayor candidates held on the 12th, 22 days before the June 3 local elections, Democratic Party candidate Jeon Jae-soo and People Power Party candidate Park Hyung-joon clashed fiercely over allegations of receiving money from the Unification Church and preferential sales of LCT. Candidate Jeon said to Candidate Park, “You said you’d sell LCT, so why haven’t you sold it?” Candidate Park retorted, “Did the Cartier fall from the sky?” (6·3 지방선거를 22일 앞두고 12일 처음 열린 부산시장 후보 TV 토론회에서 더불어민주당 전재수 후보와 국민의힘 박형준 후보가 통일교 금품 수수 의혹과 엘시티 특혜 분양 의혹을 놓고 거세게 맞섰다. 전 후보는 박 후보를 향해 “엘시티 판다더니 왜 안 팔고 있느냐”고 했고, 박 후보는 전 후보에게 “까르띠에는 하늘에서 떨어졌냐”고 했다.)

During the debate hosted by Busan MBC that afternoon, the two candidates engaged in a negative exchange. In the lead-off segment, Candidate Park grilled Candidate Jeon for about 10 minutes over the alleged receipt of money from the Unification Church, pressing him with, “Clearly answer whether you received it or not.” (이날 오후 부산MBC 주최로 열린 토론회에서 두 후보는 네거티브 공방을 벌였다. 박 후보는 주도권 토론에서 10분가량 전 후보의 통일교 금품 수수 의혹에 대해 집중적으로 캐물으며 “받았는지 안 받았는지 명확하게 답을 하라”며 전 후보를 몰아붙였다.)

Candidate Park said, “This is what our citizens are most curious about,” and asked, “Have you been to Cheonjeonggung? Didn’t you receive a Cartier watch?” Candidate Jeon replied, “I sincerely apologize and feel sorry to the Busan citizens for being at the center of this controversy,” but added, “Don’t try to gain votes through negative tactics.” (박 후보는 “우리 시민들이 제일 궁금해하는 일”이라며 “천정궁에 가신 적이 있느냐, 까르띠에 시계를 안 받았느냐”고 했다. 전 후보는 “논란의 중심에 서게 된 것에 대해 부산 시민들께 정말 송구스럽고 죄송하다”면서도 “네거티브를 통해 표를 얻겠다는 식으로는 하지는 마시라”고 했다.)

When Candidate Park pressed again, “Have you been to Cheonjeonggung or not? Just tell me that,” Candidate Jeon said, “The investigative results regarding my meeting at Cheonjeonggung are already out.” He continued, “Regarding that issue, I have undergone an intense investigation by the joint prosecution and police task force over the past four months,” and “I have consistently stated the clear fact that there was no illegal receipt of money or goods during the investigation.” (전 후보는 박 후보가 재차 “천정궁에 가셨나, 안 가셨나. 그것만 얘기해보시라”고 하자 “천정궁에 가서 만난 것은 수사 결과가 나와 있다”고 했다. 그러면서 “(해당) 문제에 대해서는 지난 4개월 동안 검경 합동 수사 본부를 통해 강도 높은 수사를 받았다”며 “조사에서 일체 불법적인 금품 수수가 없다는 명확한 사실을 일관되게 진술했다”고 했다.)

Candidate Park then asked, “Then did the Cartier watch fall from the sky? How is it that your closest friend entrusted that Cartier watch for repair?” Candidate Jeon responded, “He’s not a friend.” (그러자 박 후보는 “그럼 까르띠에 시계가 하늘에서 떨어졌느냐”며 “어떻게 전 후보의 가장 친한 친구가 그 까르띠에 시계를 수리를 맡기냐”고 했다. 전 후보는 “친구 아니다”라고 했다.)

Candidate Jeon counterattacked, accusing Candidate Park of failing to keep his promise to sell the LCT apartments. Candidate Jeon said, “Just take LCT—you promised the citizens you’d sell it, but you still haven’t, haven’t you? You can’t even keep a simple promise, yet you’re trying to paint me as a liar.” (전 후보는 박 후보의 엘시티 아파트 매각 약속을 지키지 않고 있다고 반격했다. 전 후보는 “엘시티만 하더라도 시민에게 (판다고) 약속해 놓고 아직도 안 팔고 있지 않으냐”며 “쉽게 지킬 수 있는 약속조차 지키지 않으면서 저에게 거짓말 프레임을 씌우고 있다”고 했다.)

Candidate Park responded, “I apologize for not keeping my word,” and explained, “There are personal circumstances—I’m a victim of the jeonse crisis and can’t move my home right now.” He added, “Out of regret, I donated all my real estate, and I and my wife have been making large donations.” (박 후보는 “공언한 것을 지키지 못한 것은 죄송스럽게 생각한다”며 “지금 전세 피해자가 돼서 집을 옮길 수 없는 개인 사정이 있다”고 했다. 그러면서 “미안한 마음에 제 부동산은 모두 기부했고 아내와 고액 기부를 해왔다”고 했다.)

item.title: Ruling Party Holds Honam Candidate Convention... "Jeong Cheong-rae, Apologize" Funeral Protest (與, 호남 공천자 대회 열었는데... “정청래 사죄하라” 상복 시위)
item.description:
Ruling Party Holds Honam Candidate Convention... "Jeong Cheong-rae, Apologize" Funeral Protest (與, 호남 공천자 대회 열었는데... “정청래 사죄하라” 상복 시위)

Jeong Cheong-rae, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, held a candidate convention in Honam region in South Jeolla Province on the 12th, rallying support in the party's stronghold. However, outside the venue, a protest rally denouncing Leader Jeong over the party's June 3 local elections nominations took place. It is reported that Leader Jeong eventually entered the venue through the back door. <<> That afternoon, near the Gangjin Second Indoor Gymnasium in South Jeolla Province, where the candidate convention for South Jeolla, Gwangju, and North Jeolla was held, some Democratic Party members and others staged a protest demanding Leader Jeong's resignation over the nomination for North Jeolla Province governor. They argued that the Jeong Cheong-rae leadership had "deprived the residents of their right to choose" by expelling North Jeolla Governor Kim Gwan-yeong from the party amid the controversy over the payment of designated driver fees. Earlier, Governor Kim had declared his independent candidacy in opposition to the party's decision. <<> Leader Jeong said on this day, "My wife was born right here in Gangjin County, South Jeolla Province," adding, "I greet you as Gangjin's son-in-law, Honam's son-in-law, and party leader Jeong Cheong-rae." Some protest participants targeted this with a banner reading, "Mr. Jeong, who nominated a candidate with five criminal convictions, don't come to your wife's hometown!" This criticized the Democratic Party for nominating a candidate with a criminal record for the Gangjin County head election. <<> Additionally, a protest rally was held regarding the primary for the South Jeolla-Gwangju Integrated Special City mayor. The protesters claimed that despite an incident where 2,308 responses were mishandled during the primary process, the Democratic Party leadership pushed ahead with the nomination. <<> Some people appeared at the protest wearing funeral clothes. It is said that some protest participants attempted to enter the gymnasium, leading to physical altercations with party officials. <<> Leader Jeong continued his remarks targeting Governor Kim Gwan-yeong, who is running as an independent, at the candidate convention. "The reason Mount Everest is the tallest is because it sits on top of the Himalayan mountain range," Jeong said. He then referred to Democratic Party candidates Lee Won-taek for North Jeolla governor and Min Hyeong-bae for South Jeolla-Gwangju Integrated City mayor, stating, "They are the proud candidates of the Democratic Party that we must elect," and added, "We should think that they stand out because they are Democratic Party candidates, like the Himalayan range. Because they are embraced by the Democratic Party, their chances of winning are high, and they are receiving applause and expectations from many people." (정청래 더불어민주당 대표는 12일 전남에서 호남 지역 공천자 대회를 열어 텃밭 세 결집에 나섰다. 그러나 이날 행사장 앞에선 민주당의 6·3 지방선거 공천과 관련해 정 대표를 규탄하는 집회가 벌어졌다. 정 대표는 결국 후문으로 행사장에 입장한 것으로 전해졌다.)

item.title: “Uniting Conservative Voters to Stop the Rampage of the Pro-Government Camp” (“보수 유권자 하나로 묶어 범여권의 폭주 막겠다”)
item.description:
“Uniting Conservative Voters to Stop the Rampage of the Pro-Government Camp” (“보수 유권자 하나로 묶어 범여권의 폭주 막겠다”)

On the 12th, at an intersection in Anjung-eup, Pyeongtaek, Gyeonggi Province. The window of a car waiting for a traffic light rolled down, and a man popped his head out. “Senior, I’m your junior from 10 years of elementary, middle, and high school. Yoo Ui-dong! Yoo Ui-dong!” Yoo Ui-dong, a candidate from the People Power Party who was campaigning on the streets, waved and urged, “Junior, don’t just do this alone—tell those around you too.” (12일 경기 평택시 안중읍 사거리. 신호 대기 중인 차량의 창문이 열리더니 한 남성이 고개를 내밀었다. “선배님, 제가 초·중·고 10년 후배입니다. 유의동! 유의동!” 거리 유세를 하던 국민의힘 유의동 후보는 손을 흔들며 당부했다. “후배님, 혼자서만 그러지 말고 주변에도 얘기해줘.”)

Running in the June 3rd Pyeongtaek-eul by-election, Candidate Yoo is championing the slogan “A lifetime in Pyeongtaek.” A former three-term lawmaker and native of Pyeongtaek, he raised all three of his daughters there. Candidate Yoo said, “I proposed to other candidates that they pledge to stay in Pyeongtaek after the election and contribute to the city’s development, but no one responded.” This election, held two years after former Democratic Party lawmaker Lee Byeong-jin was disqualified from office for failing to disclose assets, features Candidate Yoo alongside Democratic Party candidate Kim Yong-nam, Rebuilding Korea Party candidate Cho Kuk, Progressive Party candidate Kim Jae-yeon, and Liberty and Innovation Party candidate Hwang Kyo-ahn. <<> In an interview that day, Candidate Yoo criticized other candidates who moved to Pyeongtaek ahead of the election. Regarding the controversy over Cho Kuk’s short-term monthly rent contract for an apartment in Pyeongtaek, Yoo said, “It doesn’t make sense commonsensically—wouldn’t Pyeongtaek residents see it as a signal that he’ll leave right after the election?” About Kim Yong-nam, he remarked, “Isn’t he someone who tried to run in the Hanam-gap by-election in Gyeonggi but got pushed to Pyeongtaek? He doesn’t talk about Pyeongtaek and just keeps wrestling with Cho Kuk day in and day out.” <<> In this Pyeongtaek-eul by-election, whether candidates unite is expected to significantly impact the outcome. Regarding the possibility of a merger between pro-government candidates Kim Yong-nam and Cho Kuk, Candidate Yoo said, “Can two candidates who attack each other every day suddenly say, ‘That candidate is great, so support them’?” On the possibility of a conservative merger between himself and Hwang Kyo-ahn, he stated, “I won’t say the chance is zero, but for now, the priority is uniting conservative voters.” Candidate Yoo added, “I will judge arrogant politicians who treat Pyeongtaek like a playground and stop the rampage of the massive ruling party.” <<> Candidate Yoo said, “During my time as a lawmaker, Pyeongtaek’s population grew to 600,000, and the city budget reached 2.2 trillion won—quantitative growth. Now, I will achieve qualitative growth.” He cites improving metropolitan transportation networks connecting to the Seoul capital area as a key pledge. Regarding the People Power Party, Yoo said, “If elected, as a senior lawmaker from the Seoul metropolitan area, I will transform the People Power Party into a truly national party.” (6·3 경기 평택을 재선거에 출마한 유 후보는 ‘평생을 평택에서’라는 구호를 내세우고 있다. 3선 의원 출신인 그는 평택 출신으로 세 딸을 모두 평택에서 키웠다. 유 후보는 “다른 후보들에게 ‘선거 이후에도 평택에 남아 도시 발전에 힘을 보태겠다’는 서약을 제안했지만 누구도 응답하지 않았다”고 했다. 더불어민주당 이병진 전 의원이 재산 신고 누락 혐의로 당선 무효형을 받아 2년 만에 치러지는 이번 선거엔 유 후보와 함께 민주당 김용남 후보, 조국혁신당 조국 후보, 김재연 진보당 후보, 황교안 자유와혁신 후보가 출마했다.)

item.title: Ruling Party Candidates Avoiding Debates… Safe Strategy or Lack of Ability? (토론 피하는 與후보들… 안전 운행인가, 실력 부족인가)
item.description:
Ruling Party Candidates Avoiding Debates… Safe Strategy or Lack of Ability? (토론 피하는 與후보들… 안전 운행인가, 실력 부족인가)

Major candidates of the Democratic Party of Korea running in the June 3 local elections and parliamentary by-elections are avoiding proposals for one-on-one debates from People Power Party candidates. With Democratic candidates generally leading in polls across various regions, this is interpreted as a strategy to maintain a stable lead without giving opponents an opportunity for a counterattack through debates. In contrast, People Power Party candidates are pushing back, arguing that they "want to avoid verifying regional policies and visions through debates and instead rely on image-based campaigning." (6·3 지방선거와 국회의원 재·보궐선거에 출마하는 더불어민주당 주요 후보들이 국민의힘 후보들의 양자 토론 제안을 피하고 있다. 민주당 후보들이 각 지역에서 대체로 여론조사 1위를 기록하는 가운데, 토론회로 반격의 빌미를 제공하지 않고 안정 운행하겠다는 전략으로 해석된다. 반면 국민의힘 후보들은 “토론을 통해 지역 정책과 비전을 검증받지 않고 이미지 선거만 하려 한다”며 반발했다.)

In the Seoul mayoral race, one of the biggest battlegrounds in this local election, Democratic candidate Jung Won-oh has been repeatedly rejecting the People Power Party's Oh Se-hoon's demand for a one-on-one debate. On the 11th, the Korea Broadcast Journalists Club debate proceeded solely with Oh after Jung declined to participate in a bilateral debate, with Jung holding a separate event on the 19th. In the 2021 Seoul mayoral by-election and the 2022 local elections, bilateral debates between the Democratic candidate (Park Young-sun or Song Young-gil) and the People Power candidate (Oh Se-hoon) were held. (이번 지방선거 최대 승부처 중 하나인 서울시장 선거에서 국민의힘 오세훈 후보의 양자 토론 요구를 민주당 정원오 후보가 계속 거부하는 중이다. 지난 11일 방송기자클럽 토론회는 정 후보의 양자 토론 거부로 오 후보 단독으로 진행됐고, 정 후보는 19일에 따로 한다. 지난 2021년 서울시장 보궐선거와 2022년 지방선거 때 진행된 방송기자클럽 토론회에선 민주당 후보(박영선·송영길)와 국민의힘 후보(오세훈) 간 양자 토론이 이뤄졌다.)

Oh also requested one-on-one debates at forums hosted by the Korean Newspaper and Broadcasting Editors Association (on the 14th) and the Gwanhun Club (on the 20th), but Jung reportedly refused. As a result, the two candidates are expected to attend each forum separately, with one in the morning and the other in the afternoon. Oh's camp remarked, "This shows that Jung himself admits he lacks understanding of city administration." Meanwhile, Jung's side countered, "Oh is insisting on bilateral debates to stir up unnecessary political conflict." (오 후보는 한국신문방송편집인협회(14일)과 관훈클럽(20일) 토론회도 양자 토론을 요구했으나 역시 정 후보가 거부했다고 한다. 결국 두 후보는 두 토론회 당일 오전, 오후에 각각 참석할 예정이다. 오 후보 측은 “정 후보가 시정(市政) 이해도가 떨어진다는 걸 스스로 밝힌 것”이라고 했다. 반면 정 후보 측은 “오 후보가 불필요한 정쟁을 만들기 위해 양자 토론을 고집한다”고 했다.)

The People Power Party has strongly criticized Jung. Secretary-General Jung Hee-yong said on the 12th, "Is a one-on-one debate with Oh so frightening?" adding, "Dragging things out and holding out like playing defensive football is an arrogance that ignores citizens." Lawmaker Kim Jae-seop also said on SBS Radio the same day, "He can bring an aide; let's even do a two-on-one debate if it comes to that." (국민의힘은 정 후보를 강하게 비판했다. 정희용 사무총장은 12일 “오 후보와의 일대일 토론이 그렇게 두렵나”라며 “시간을 끌면서 침대 축구 하듯이 버텨보겠다는 태도는 시민을 무시하는 오만함”이라고 했다. 김재섭 의원도 이날 SBS 라디오에서 “보좌관을 끼고 나와도 좋으니 2대 1 토론이라도 하자”고 했다.)

In the Gyeonggi Province governor race, Democratic candidate Choo Mi-ae is likewise avoiding debate requests from People Power candidate Yang Hyang-ja. Yang asked, "Is doing nothing Choo's biggest strategy?" In response, Choo said, "Saying 'I'll do this' is the way to build political trust. I've done that throughout my six terms as a lawmaker. Learn a thing or two from a senior." (경기지사 선거 역시 국민의힘 양향자 후보의 토론 요구를 민주당 추미애 후보가 피하는 양상이다. 양 후보는 “추 후보는 아무것도 안 하는 것이 최대 전략이냐”고 했다. 이에 추 후보는 “‘나는 이렇게 하겠다’고 하는 게 정치 신뢰를 높일 수 있는 길”이라며 “저는 6선 국회의원을 하는 동안 그렇게 해왔다. 선배한테 좀 배우라”고 했다.)

In the Busan North Gap by-election, Democratic candidate Ha Jung-woo stated he would not attend individual media debates, saying, "Who picks verbal fights while running a race?" In response, People Power candidate Park Min-sik argued, "Being transparently tested before voters is a candidate's basic duty." Independent candidate Han Dong-hoon added, "Are voters supposed to just vote for someone sent by President Lee Jae-myung without knowing Ha's stance? Don't run away from debates." (부산 북갑 보궐선거에선 민주당 하정우 후보가 “누가 경기 뛰는데 말싸움 합니까”라고 하는 등 개별 언론 토론회는 불참한다는 입장이다. 그러자 국민의힘 박민식 후보는 “유권자 앞에서 당당히 검증받는 것이 후보의 기본 책무”라고 했다. 무소속 한동훈 후보도 “(주민이) 하 후보 생각도 모른 채 그냥 이재명 대통령이 보낸 사람이라 찍어줘야 하는 것이냐”라며 “토론을 피하고 도망가지 말라”고 했다.)

Under the Public Official Election Act, elections for metropolitan heads and National Assembly members must hold at least one debate or discussion hosted by the Election Broadcasting Debate Commission. Candidates from both parties are expected to set dates, numbers, and formats for debates regionally after the official candidate registration period on the 14th-15th. Consequently, candidates have no legal obligation to participate in debates hosted by individual media outlets beyond those mandated by law. This is why many Democratic candidates are adopting a strategy of only attending debates organized by the National Election Commission. (공직선거법상 광역 단체장·국회의원 선거는 1회 이상 선거방송토론위원회 주관 대담·토론회를 열어야 한다. 여야 후보는 공식 후보 등록일인 14~15일 이후 지역별로 토론회 날짜와 횟수, 방식 등을 정할 예정이다. 이에 따라 후보가 법정 토론 이외의 개별 언론 등이 주관하는 토론에 참여할 법적 의무는 없다. 이 때문에 민주당 후보 다수가 선관위 주최 토론만 나가겠다는 전략을 쓰고 있는 것이다.)

A key Democratic Party official said, "With our candidates leading in places like Seoul and Gyeonggi, we see no need to take risks by going to debates and making verbal mistakes that could cost votes. And there's no obligation to attend debates beyond those from the election commission, right?" (민주당 핵심 관계자는 “서울, 경기 등에서 우리 후보가 우위를 점하고 있는 상황에서 굳이 토론회에 나가서 말실수를 하고 표를 깎아먹을 필요가 없다는 생각”이라며 “특히 선관위 토론 말고 다른 토론을 해야 할 의무도 없지 않냐”고 했다.)

However, candidates for Busan mayor and Gangwon governor from both parties have already agreed to and held debates hosted by local broadcasters. That said, Democratic Gangwon governor candidate Woo Sang-ho faced controversy on the 11th during a debate hosted by three local media outlets when he responded to People Power candidate Kim Jin-tae's question about 'Hongje-dong' in Gangneung with, "Is that Seoul's Hongje-dong or Wonju's Hongje-dong?" The People Power Party criticized it as "a farce resulting from a Seoul politician coming to Gangwon," while within the Democratic Party, remarks surfaced like, "See, debates are risky." (하지만 여야의 부산시장 후보, 강원지사 후보는 합의해 지역 방송사가 주최하는 토론회를 이미 진행한 바 있다. 다만 민주당 우상호 강원지사 후보는 지난 11일 지역 언론 3사 토론회에서 국민의힘 김진태 후보의 ‘(강릉시) 홍제동’ 질문에 “서울 홍제동이냐, 원주 홍제동이냐”고 했다가 논란이 되기도 했다. 국민의힘은 “서울 정치인이 강원에 오니 발생한 촌극”이라고 비판했고, 민주당 내에선 “역시 토론회는 위험하다”란 말이 나왔다.)

A People Power Party official said, "Democratic candidates are afraid that participating in one-on-one debates, which allow more speaking time than multi-party ones, will expose their lack of skill." A Democratic Party official countered, "For candidates leading in polls, it's only natural to manage their current approval ratings steadily as part of election strategy. People Power candidates would be just as reluctant to debate if the tables were turned." (국민의힘 관계자는 “민주당 후보들이 다자 토론보다 발언 시간이 많은 양자 토론에 나가면 자신의 미숙함이 드러날까 봐 두려운 것”이라고 했다. 민주당 관계자는 “여론조사에서 앞서가는 후보들 입장에선 현 지지율을 안정적으로 관리하는 게 당연한 선거 전략”이라며 “국민의힘 후보들도 반대 상황이면 토론에 소극적일 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Tickets cost 10,000 won each, but Unification Ministry gives 300 million won to North Korea cheering groups (입장권 1만원인데… 北축구 응원단체에 통일부, 3억원 지원)
item.description:
Tickets cost 10,000 won each, but Unification Ministry gives 300 million won to North Korea cheering groups (입장권 1만원인데… 北축구 응원단체에 통일부, 3억원 지원)

The government announced on the 12th that it will allocate 300 million won from the Inter-Korean Cooperation Fund to private organizations supporting North Korea, under the pretext of purchasing tickets and other costs, to cheer for the North Korean women's football club "Naegohyang Women's Football Team" visiting South Korea for the 2025-2026 Asian Football Confederation (AFC) Women's Champions League semi-finals. This has sparked controversy over fairness compared to ordinary football fans who pay such expenses out of their own pockets. Additionally, North Korea is known to be reluctant to engage in external contacts beyond the games, raising questions about whether this qualifies as an "inter-Korean exchange and cooperation promotion project" eligible for support under the law. (정부가 2025~2026시즌 아시아축구연맹(AFC) 여자 챔피언스 리그 준결승 경기에 참가하기 위해 방남(訪南)하는 북한 여자 축구 클럽 ‘내고향여자축구단’을 응원하는 대북 민간 단체들에 입장권 구매 등의 명목으로 남북협력기금 3억원을 지급하겠다고 12일 밝혔다. 이런 비용을 자비로 지불하는 일반 축구 팬과의 형평성이 맞지 않는다는 논란이 일고 있다. 북한 측이 경기 외의 외부 접촉도 꺼리는 것으로 알려져, 법에 따라 지원할 수 있는 ‘남북교류·협력 증진 사업’이 맞느냐는 논란도 예상된다.)

A Unification Ministry official said on the day, "We have accepted various requests from private organizations wishing to cheer for the North Korean football team and decided to provide 300 million won from the Inter-Korean Exchange and Cooperation Fund to these organizations," adding, "The 300 million won covers ticket costs and expenses for making cheering tools like placards." The Naegohyang Women's Football Team will enter South Korea via Incheon Airport on the 17th through Beijing, China, and then face Suwon FC Women in the semi-final at Suwon Sports Complex in Gyeonggi Province on the 20th. If the North Korean team wins the semi-final, they will also play the final on the 23rd, hence the allocation of 300 million won. (통일부 당국자는 이날 “북한 축구팀을 응원하고자 하는 민간 단체들의 여러 요청을 받아들여 응원에 나서는 민간 단체들에 남북교류협력기금 3억원을 지급하기로 결정했다”며 “티켓 비용과 피켓 등 응원 도구 제작 비용 등으로 3억원을 잡은 것”이라고 말했다. 내고향여자축구단은 17일 중국 베이징을 경유해 인천공항으로 국내 입국한 뒤 20일 경기도 수원 종합운동장에서 수원FC위민과 준결승전을 치른다. 만약 준결승전에서 북한 팀이 승리하면 23일 결승전 경기도 치러야 해 3억원을 책정했다는 것이다.)

It is reported that the total size of the cheering groups recruited by domestic private organizations supporting North Korea to cheer for the North Korean players is around 2,500 to 3,000 people. Tickets for the semi-final and final, which went on sale from the 12th, are priced at 10,000 won for adults, 5,000 won for teenagers, and 3,000 won for children. Groups of 30 or more can receive a 50% discount. Assuming 2,500 adults receive the group discount, the total ticket purchase cost would be 12.5 million won. (국내 대북 민간단체들이 북한 선수들을 응원하기 위해 모집한 응원단 전체 규모는 약 2500명~3000명 수준인 것으로 알려졌다. 12일부터 판매가 시작된 이번 준결승·결승전 입장권 가격은 성인 1만원, 청소년 5000원, 어린이 3000원이다. 30인 이상 단체는 50% 할인을 받을 수 있다. 성인 2500명이 단체 할인을 적용받는다고 가정할 경우, 입장권 구입 비용은 총 1250만원이다.)

North Korea has notified that a total of 39 people, including 27 players (including 4 reserves) and 12 support staff, will visit South Korea. The government has collectively received the North Korean delegation's application for approval to visit through the Korea Football Association and plans to complete administrative procedures before their arrival. This marks the North Korean delegation's first participation in a domestic sports event in about eight years, since the 2018 International Table Tennis Federation (ITTF) World Tour Grand Finals. (북한은 예비 선수 4명을 포함한 선수 27명과 지원 인력 12명 등 총 39명이 방남한다고 통보했다. 정부는 대한축구협회를 통해 북측 선수단의 방남 승인 신청을 일괄 접수했고, 북한 선수단 도착 전에 행정적 절차를 마무리할 예정이다. 북한 선수단이 국내에서 열리는 스포츠 행사에 참가하는 것은 2018년 국제탁구연맹(ITTF) 월드투어 그랜드파이널 이후 약 8년 만의 일이다.)

item.title: Hegseth Tells Ahn Kyu-baek to "Stand Shoulder to Shoulder"... Pressuring South Korea to Join Iran Operation (헤그세스, 안규백에 “어깨 나란히 하라”… 이란 작전 동참 압박)
item.description:
Hegseth Tells Ahn Kyu-baek to "Stand Shoulder to Shoulder"... Pressuring South Korea to Join Iran Operation (헤그세스, 안규백에 “어깨 나란히 하라”… 이란 작전 동참 압박)

U.S. Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth, during a ROK-U.S. defense ministers' meeting held in the United States on the 11th (local time), mentioned the U.S. military operation against Iran, "Great Fury," and stated, "We expect our partners to stand shoulder to shoulder with us." In his opening remarks at the meeting with South Korean Defense Minister Ahn Kyu-baek at the Pentagon in Arlington, Virginia, Hegseth said, "In the current global threat environment, the strength of our alliance is decisive." <<> With the government officially confirming on the 10th that the multipurpose carrier "Namuh," operated by South Korea's largest shipping company HMM, was 'struck' in the Strait of Hormuz, analysts suggest that this amounts to renewed and open pressure on South Korea to participate in or contribute to the U.S. operation in some form. U.S. President Donald Trump also said in a Fox News interview on the same day that he is considering resuming "Project Freedom," an operation to support ships transiting the Strait of Hormuz. Just after the Namuh was struck on the 4th, President Trump stated, "Iran attacked a South Korean cargo ship," and added, "It seems like it's time for South Korea to come and join the mission." <<> In his opening remarks, Minister Ahn did not specifically mention the Middle East situation, stating, "The ROK-U.S. alliance has been a reliable foundation together even in difficult times, and we will continue to cooperate closely with one voice." He added, "We are doing our utmost to secure core national defense capabilities through defense cost increases and realize a Korea-led defense of the Korean Peninsula." This can be seen as highlighting South Korea's efforts to meet the Trump administration's demands for increased defense spending from allies, while bringing up the issue of wartime operational control (OPCON) transition with the phrase "realizing a Korea-led defense of the Korean Peninsula." Experts have analyzed that "South Korea and the United States revealed differing perceptions over security priorities." <<> The South Korean government, which is pushing for the OPCON transition within President Lee Jae-myung's term, is reportedly seeking to set 2028 as the target year for the transition. However, U.S. Forces Korea Commander General Xavier Brunson recently mentioned the first quarter of 2029 as the target timeframe for meeting the conditions for OPCON transition in a U.S. Congress briefing. As a result, Minister Ahn is known to have raised the OPCON transition issue extensively during this meeting. <<> The joint press statement released after the meeting also included the phrase that Minister Ahn "explained South Korea's recent efforts for defense cost increases, securing core military capabilities, and taking the lead in defending the Korean Peninsula." This can be seen as emphasizing the South Korean government's commitment to OPCON transition. However, the statement did not include any specific mention of the "timeline for OPCON transition." It only contained a general expression that "the two ministers discussed major alliance issues, including OPCON transition and alliance modernization, and agreed to strengthen future cooperation." <<> According to the statement, Secretary Hegseth "emphasized the importance of adopting a realistic and practical approach to deter threats and strengthen the ROK-U.S. combined defense posture while modernizing the alliance." This can be interpreted as implying that to counter multifaceted threats from China, Russia, and Iran, the U.S. needs the flexibility to deploy U.S. Forces Korea assets or troops. <<> Regarding the South Korean government's interest in introducing nuclear-powered submarines, Deputy Defense Ministry Spokesperson Lee Kyung-ho said on the 12th that the issue was "discussed" during this meeting, but it was not included in the joint press statement. While South Korea and the U.S. agreed to cooperate on South Korea's introduction of nuclear-powered submarines during last year's summit, follow-up consultations have stalled due to issues such as delays in U.S. investment. <<> Although this meeting took place amid the U.S. restriction of intelligence sharing on North Korea since early last month following remarks made by Unification Minister Chung Dong-young about a "highly enriched uranium facility," this issue was also not mentioned in the joint press statement. In response to a question about whether related discussions occurred, Spokesperson Lee only replied, "A comprehensive discussion was held on major alliance issues." One security expert commented, "This was a meeting that only highlighted the U.S. bill demanding South Korea's participation in the military operation against Iran." (피트 헤그세스 미국 전쟁부(국방부) 장관이 11일(현지 시각) 미국에서 열린 한미 국방장관 회담에서 미국의 대(對)이란 군사작전인 ‘장대한 분노’를 언급하며 “우리는 파트너들이 우리와 어깨를 나란히 하기를 기대하고 있다”고 말했다. 헤그세스 장관은 이날 버지니아주(州) 알링턴의 미 국방부 청사에서 열린 안규백 국방부 장관과의 회담 모두발언에서 “현재의 글로벌 위협 환경 속에서 우리 동맹의 힘은 결정적”이라며 이렇게 말했다.)

item.title: President Lee: “Consumption is a Virtue Now… Populist Austerity Fiscal Theory is Irresponsible” (李대통령 “지금은 소비가 미덕… 포퓰리즘 긴축재정론은 무책임”)
item.description:
President Lee: “Consumption is a Virtue Now… Populist Austerity Fiscal Theory is Irresponsible” (李대통령 “지금은 소비가 미덕… 포퓰리즘 긴축재정론은 무책임”)

President Lee Jae-myung stated at the Cabinet meeting and emergency economic review meeting held at the Blue House on the 12th, “There are voices in some parts of society, like a repetitive song, demanding austerity under the pretext of national debt,” and “We must not fall into the trap of populist austerity fiscal theory that deceives the eyes of the people.” (이재명 대통령은 12일 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의 겸 비상경제점검회의에서 “국가 채무를 명분으로 긴축을 강요하는 목소리가 마치 돌림노래처럼 사회 일각에 존재한다”며 “국민의 눈을 속이는 포퓰리즘적인 긴축재정론의 함정에 빠져서는 안 된다”고 했다.)

President Lee said on this day, “(Austerity fiscal theory) is essentially an irresponsible voice that condones the suffering of the people,” and “The government must focus its efforts on laying the foundation for a great leap forward in the national economy through active fiscal policies.” He added, “Looking at the actual debt, which considers not just nominal debt but also how many bonds and receivables Korea has, it amounts to about 10% of GDP.” (이 대통령은 이날 “(긴축재정론은) 사실상 민생 고통을 수수방관하라는 무책임한 목소리”라며 “정부는 적극적인 재정 정책을 통해 국민 경제 대도약의 발판을 닦는 데 역량을 집중해야 한다”고 했다. 이어 “우리나라의 명목상 채무가 아닌 실제 채무와 채권이 얼마나 있는지를 따진 실질적 채무를 살펴보면 국내총생산(GDP) 대비 10% 정도”라고 했다.)

President Lee also said, “There was a time when thrift was a virtue, but now we live in an era where consumption has become a virtue.” He continued, “This is hardly a time to keep taking on debt,” but added, “In times like these, it is the government’s role to ensure economic circulation through investment.” (이 대통령은 또 “한때 절약이 미덕일 때가 있었지만 지금은 소비가 미덕인 시대가 된 것”이라고 했다. 이어 “자꾸 빚을 낼 일도 아니다”라면서도 “이럴 때는 투자를 통해 경제가 순환하게 하는 게 정부의 역할”이라고 했다.)

Professor Kang Sung-jin of Korea University (President of the Korean Economic Association) said, “The current low national debt ratio is thanks to the increase in GDP from rising national wealth due to the semiconductor supercycle,” and “Excessive expansionary fiscal policies need to be guarded against.” (강성진 고려대 교수(한국경제학회장)는 “현재의 낮은 국가 채무 비율은 반도체 수퍼사이클에 따른 국부 증대로 GDP가 커진 덕”이라며 “과도한 확장 재정 정책은 경계할 필요가 있다”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, President Lee remarked, “As the Middle East war enters its 11th week, some prices, centered on petroleum products, are showing instability,” and “Nevertheless, through the government’s efforts to overcome the crisis, the people have pooled their strength, and the economy remains robust even amid the crisis.” However, he did not mention the Korean HMM ‘Namu’ that was struck by an unidentified aircraft in the Strait of Hormuz, even on this day. (한편 이 대통령은 “중동 전쟁이 11주 차에 접어들며 석유류 가격을 중심으로 일부 물가에서 불안한 모습을 보이고 있다”며 “그럼에도 정부의 위기 극복 노력 속에 국민이 힘을 모아주며 경제가 위기 속에서도 견조한 모습을 보이고 있다”고 했다. 다만 호르무즈 해역에서 미상의 비행체에 피격된 한국 HMM ‘나무호’에 대해서는 이날도 언급하지 않았다.)

The Blue House announced on the 12th that President Lee is scheduled to receive visits from U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Chinese State Council Vice Premier He Lifeng, who are coming to South Korea on the 13th for U.S.-China negotiations ahead of President Donald Trump’s visit to China. The top economic officials from the U.S. and China plan to discuss trade and global supply chain issues ahead of the U.S.-China summit set to begin on the 14th in Beijing, China. However, it was reported that no separate bilateral meeting with South Korea’s counterpart, Minister of Finance and Economy Koo Yun-cheol, is scheduled. (이 대통령은 도널드 트럼프 미 대통령의 방중을 앞두고 13일 미·중 협상을 위해 한국을 방문하는 스콧 베선트 미 재무장관, 허리펑 중국 국무원 부총리의 예방을 받을 예정이라고 청와대가 12일 밝혔다. 미·중 경제 수장인 두 사람은 14일부터 중국 베이징에서 열리는 미·중 정상회담을 앞두고 무역, 글로벌 공급망 문제 등을 논의할 예정이다. 다만 한국 측 카운터파트인 구윤철 재정경제부 장관과의 별도 양자 회담은 예정되지 않은 것으로 알려졌다.)

item.title: “People’s Power is Zero, Ultimately a Two-Way Race… Kim Yong-nam is Someone Who Attacked Lee” (“국힘은 제로, 결국 2파전… 김용남은 李 공격한 사람”)
item.description:
“People’s Power is Zero, Ultimately a Two-Way Race… Kim Yong-nam is Someone Who Attacked Lee” (“국힘은 제로, 결국 2파전… 김용남은 李 공격한 사람”)

“I didn’t see the glass door. Oh, I was so flustered that it happened…” On the evening of the 12th, at the campaign office in Anjung-eup, Pyeongtaek, Gyeonggi Province, Cho Kuk, the candidate from the Rebuilding Korea Party, had a visibly bruised right eye. He said he had hit the door hard while finishing up his regional schedule. Candidate Cho, who is running in the Pyeongtaek by-election for the National Assembly, stated, “I’m visiting every town, village, and neighborhood from 6 a.m. until late at night with ‘on-foot campaigning,’” adding, “I’ll walk steadily and respond firmly to key issues.” (“유리문을 못 봤네요. 아유, 정신이 없어서 그만….” 12일 저녁 경기 평택 안중읍의 선거사무소에서 만난 조국 조국혁신당 후보의 오른쪽 눈은 시퍼렇게 멍이 들어 있었다. 지역 일정을 마치고 나서는 길에 문에 세게 부딪혔다고 했다. 평택을 국회의원 재선거에 출마한 조 후보는 “매일 오전 6시부터 심야까지 각 읍면동을 ‘뚜벅이 유세’로 방문하고 있다”며 “뚜벅뚜벅 걷고 쟁점에는 따박따박 대응하겠다”고 했다.)

On this day, Candidate Cho visited an apartment complex in Godeok-dong, Pyeongtaek, Gyeonggi Province, for a meeting with residents. When a resident shook his hand and was surprised saying, “You’ve got a strong grip,” Cho replied, “That’s because I exercise a lot,” adding, “I go around restaurants, cafes, and bars, and it seems like I meet and shake hands with about 500 people a day.” (조 후보는 이날 오전 경기 평택 고덕동의 한 아파트를 찾아 주민과 간담회를 가졌다. 악수를 한 주민이 “손아귀 힘이 세다”며 놀라자 조 후보는 “운동을 많이 해서 그렇다”며 “식당, 카페, 술집을 다 돌면서 하루에 한 500명은 만나고 악수하는 것 같다”고 했다.)

In an interview with this newspaper, Candidate Cho said about running in Pyeongtaek, “Even though the by-election was triggered due to the Democratic Party’s fault, I chose a challenging place,” and “It’s a decision that also considers my path after the June 3 election.” He added, “I’m originally from the Busan-Gyeongnam region, and with my progressive color, I have strong support from Honam. When thinking about my future as a politician, I judged that I should take on a challenge in the central region where I have no connections and expand my base.” <<> >>> Regarding Kim Yong-nam, the Democratic Party candidate, Cho said, “In the past, Candidate Kim claimed that the direct cause of the Itaewon disaster was the protests, and said the slogan ‘Resignation is Mourning’ was an order from North Korea. He also said President Lee Jae-myung would find it hard to avoid a life sentence,” adding, “As a public figure, he has a duty to clarify his stance on this.” He emphasized, “This isn’t negative campaigning. If I had said something like that, what would the Democratic Party have said?” He also stated, “Candidate Kim, a former prosecutor, must state his position on the special counsel for fabricated indictments and the principle of abolishing prosecutors’ supplementary investigation powers.” Regarding the special counsel, Cho said the president’s case should be withdrawn from prosecution but added, “The special counsel law created by the Democratic Party should be revised to eliminate any constitutional concerns.” On the issue of opposition unity with Candidate Kim, he added, “At this point, it’s not very significant.” (조 후보는 본지 인터뷰에서 평택을 출마에 대해 “민주당 귀책사유로 재보선이 열리면서도 쉽지 않은 곳을 택한 것”이라며 “6·3 선거 이후의 행보도 염두에 둔 결정”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “나는 PK(부산·경남) 출신이고 진보적 컬러로 호남의 지지가 강하다”며 “정치인으로서 진로를 생각할 때 연고가 없는 중부권에서 승부를 걸어서 기반을 확대해야겠다고 판단했다”고 했다.)

Regarding Yoo Ui-dong, the People’s Power Party candidate, Cho said, “Kim Moon-soo, who defended Yoon Seok-youl and the insurrection, is the chairman of the standing election committee,” and “Pyeongtaek entrusted him with three consecutive terms over ten years, but he failed to resolve long-standing challenges.” He continued, “In Pyeongtaek, the People’s Power Party is becoming irrelevant, and in the end, it will be a fight between ‘Cho Kuk or Kim Yong-nam.’” Following his first pledge proposing the ‘new KTX Gyeonggi Southern Station’ and the ‘introduction of BRT (Bus Rapid Transit),’ Candidate Cho also pledged to attract an ‘Asia-Pacific AI (Artificial Intelligence) Center’ and develop Pyeongtaek into an AI hub. (조 후보는 김용남 민주당 후보를 향해선 “과거 김 후보는 이태원 참사의 직접적 원인이 시위라고 했고, ‘퇴진이 추모’라는 구호를 북한의 지령이라고 했다. 이재명 대통령에겐 무기징역을 면하기 어렵다고 했다”며 “공인으로서 이에 대한 입장을 밝힐 의무가 있다”고 했다. 그러면서 “이건 네거티브가 아니다. 내가 만약 그런 말을 했다면 민주당이 뭐라고 했겠나”라고 강조했다. 또 “검사 출신 김 후보는 조작기소 특검, 검사 보완수사권 폐지 원칙에 대해서도 입장을 밝혀야 한다”고 했다. 조 후보는 특검에 대해선 대통령 사건을 공소취소해야 한다면서도 “민주당이 만든 특검법은 위헌 소지가 없도록 고쳐야 한다”고 했다. 김 후보와의 범여권 단일화에 대해선 “지금 시점에 큰 의미가 없다”고도 덧붙였다.)

item.title: [Exclusive] Conscious of North Korea? Air Force Cut Live-Fire Drills to One-Quarter Last Year ([단독] 北 의식했나… 공군, 작년 실사격 훈련 4분의 1로 줄였다)
item.description:
[Exclusive] Conscious of North Korea? Air Force Cut Live-Fire Drills to One-Quarter Last Year ([단독] 北 의식했나… 공군, 작년 실사격 훈련 4분의 1로 줄였다)

The Air Force used bombs and missiles in live-fire training last year at only one-quarter the level of the previous year, it was revealed on the 12th. This is interpreted as a result of reducing South Korea-U.S. joint exercises and live-fire drills in consideration of the current administration's conciliatory stance toward North Korea. The Air Force planned eight rounds of the South Korea-U.S. joint air exercise "Ssangmae Training" last year, but actually conducted only four rounds, and plans to conduct only four rounds this year as well. <<> According to Rep. Han Ki-ho of the People Power Party, a member of the National Assembly's National Defense Committee, the Air Force used 135 rounds of bombs and missiles in live-fire training last year. This is 26.4% of the 511 rounds used in 2024. In 2022, there were 488 rounds of live-fire bomb and missile training, and in 2023, 465 rounds. The use of air-to-air missiles to suppress enemy aircraft in contingency situations decreased from 74 rounds in 2024 to 16 rounds last year. The use of air-to-ground bombs and missiles targeting ground enemy facilities and mobile missile launchers (TEL) decreased from 437 rounds to 119 rounds. <<> The Air Force explains this as being affected by the suspension of live-fire training for about three months after two KF-16 fighters mistakenly dropped eight bombs on civilian areas in Pocheon, Gyeonggi Province, in March last year. However, a military source said, "The Pocheon accident occurred due to a pilot's mistake in entering air-to-ground bomb coordinates, but it is hard to understand that the reduction in air-to-air weapon firing, which has almost no risk of accidental bombing, is greater." <<> The Air Force stated, "We are currently conducting live-fire training normally." However, from the beginning of this year to last month, only 66 rounds of live-fire ammunition and missiles have been used, and if this trend continues, it is projected to use about 200 rounds, far fewer than in previous years. The firing of guided weapons also sharply decreased, with Paveway (GBU-12) fired 11 times last year (68 times in 2024) and JDAM (GBU-31) fired 12 times last year (61 times in 2024). <<> For the F-35 stealth fighter, the Air Force's most powerful asset, with 39 currently in operation, only 7 live-fire rounds were conducted last year. This means the absolute majority of F-35 pilots have no live-fire experience for over a year. Eom Hyo-shik, director of the Korea Defense and Security Forum, said, "Shouldn't we conduct at least minimal training to demonstrate deterrence against North Korea?" Rep. Han Ki-ho said, "It's a serious problem if the administration is watching North Korea's reactions, and the military is watching the administration's reactions," adding, "We need to normalize training." (공군이 지난해 사격 훈련에 사용한 폭탄과 미사일이 전년 대비 4분의 1 수준으로 급감한 것으로 12일 나타났다. 현 정부의 대북 유화 기조를 의식해 한미 연합 연습 및 실사격 훈련 등을 축소한 결과라는 해석이 나온다. 공군은 지난해 한미 연합 공중 연습 ‘쌍매 훈련’을 8회 계획했지만 실제로는 4회만 실시했고, 올해도 4회만 실시할 계획이다.)

item.title: Launch of 'Jang Dong-hyuk Election Committee' Instead of an Innovation-Driven Committee (혁신 선대위 대신 ‘장동혁 선대위’ 출범)
item.description:
Launch of 'Jang Dong-hyuk Election Committee' Instead of an Innovation-Driven Committee (혁신 선대위 대신 ‘장동혁 선대위’ 출범)

The People Power Party announced on the 12th that it has formed an election campaign committee for the June 3 local elections, with Representative Jang Dong-hyuk as the co-chairman of the standing election committee, and will officially enter election mode. Both inside and outside the party, it is being assessed that the committee is effectively a 'one-top system' led by Representative Jang. (국민의힘은 12일 장동혁 대표를 공동 상임선대위원장으로 하는 6·3 지방선거 선거대책위원회를 구성하고 본격 선거 체제로 돌입한다고 밝혔다. 당 안팎에선 사실상 장 대표 ‘원톱 체제’로 선대위가 구성됐다는 평가가 나왔다.)

The People Power Party announced that the 'People's Election Campaign Committee to Stop the Disregard for the People and Block the Withdrawal of Indictments' will hold its launch ceremony on the 13th. The standing election committee co-chairs include Representative Jang, along with Shim Kyo-eon, a professor of real estate at Konkuk University; Yang Jun-mo, an economics professor at Yonsei University; Lee Yun-jin, a professor at Konkuk University's Institute for Healthy Aging Society; and Choi Ji-ye, a director at Jiyesu Co., Ltd., a young recruit. This lineup targets issues such as real estate, pensions, and youth affairs. <<> The co-chairpersons of the election committee include seven individuals: Floor Leader Song Eon-seok, Policy Committee Chair Chung Jeom-sik, and Supreme Council members Shin Dong-uk, Kim Min-su, Kim Jae-won, Woo Jae-jun, and Jo Kwang-han. It was initially reported that Floor Leader Song proposed to Representative Jang forming a committee centered around senior lawmakers such as Kim Ki-hyun, Na Kyung-won, and Ahn Cheol-soo, but this was not accepted. <<> The People Power Party announced it would establish a 'Committee to Block the Special Prosecutor Law on Indictment Withdrawal' under the central election committee. Lawmaker Joo Jin-woo will serve as chairman, with the aim of actively publicizing the unconstitutionality and illegality of the special prosecutor law. It will also create a 'Youth Red Wing' organization, where young people directly plan and participate. <<> Although there have been persistent calls both inside and outside the party for an innovation-focused election committee, the launch of a committee centered on Representative Jang has fallen short of expectations. Previously, Seoul mayoral candidate Oh Se-hoon and others demanded that Representative Jang form a committee that could demonstrate a shift in direction. At the time, Representative Jang said in a media interview, "I will fill the gaps and bring in individuals who can help expand our reach," and "I will build a winning election committee." <<> Meanwhile, Supreme Council member Woo Jae-jun, who was included in the election committee list, stated that he would not participate, saying, "I was included without any prior discussion." He added, "In a situation where candidates in the metropolitan area are even demanding the leadership step back to the second line, the committee was formed without any consultation," and "I will not attend the election committee's launch ceremony on the 13th." (국민의힘은 이날 ‘국민 무시 심판, 공소취소 저지 국민선거대책위원회’가 13일 출범식을 연다고 밝혔다. 상임선대위원장에는 장 대표를 비롯해 심교언 건국대 부동산학과 교수, 양준모 연세대 경제학과 교수, 이윤진 건국대 건강고령사회연구원 교수, 청년 영입 인재인 최지예 주식회사 지예수 이사가 위촉됐다. 부동산, 연금, 청년 등 이슈를 겨냥한 것이다.)

item.title: “Cho Kuk Remains in the 1980s, No Justification for Unification” (“조국은 80년대 머물러 단일화할 명분이 없어”)
item.description:
“Cho Kuk Remains in the 1980s, No Justification for Unification” (“조국은 80년대 머물러 단일화할 명분이 없어”)

Kim Yong-nam, the Democratic Party candidate running in the by-election for the Pyeongtaek-eul National Assembly seat, was at a senior welfare center in the area on the 12th, handing out business cards while personally appealing to residents. “In Pyeongtaek, it’s No. 1 anyway. Don’t overthink it—just No. 1!” he said, also making a deep bow. Those who recognized Candidate Kim cheered ‘Fighting.’ An aide from Candidate Kim’s camp said, “He’s running up to 10 such schedules every day. It shows he has no intention of losing.” That morning, Candidate Kim also greeted commuters on their way to work, wearing a placard around his neck featuring a photo of President Lee Jae-myung holding Candidate Kim’s hand. <<> A former prosecutor, Candidate Kim initially served as a first-term lawmaker for Gyeonggi Suwon under the People Power Party, then moved to the Reform Party before joining the Democratic Party last year, declaring support for President Lee during the presidential election. While some in the Pyeongtaek area’s conservative support base find him unfamiliar, Candidate Kim said in an interview with this newspaper that day, “The law firm I’ve been running has had an office in Pyeongtaek for 10 years. I have deep ties to Pyeongtaek.” <<> The Pyeongtaek-eul election is shaping up as a five-way race between Candidate Kim, People Power Party’s Yoo Eui-dong, Cho Kuk of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, Kim Jae-yeon of the Progressive Party, and Hwang Kyo-ahn of the Liberty and Innovation Party. Candidate Kim said, “Pyeongtaek-eul has become a ‘hot place.’ From a politician’s perspective, if you’re going to run, it’s good to be somewhere that draws national attention. I’m confident I’ll come in first.” <<> Regarding Candidate Yoo, Kim remarked, “No matter how much I go around Pyeongtaek-eul, I haven’t heard anyone say, ‘That’s what Rep. Yoo Eui-dong did.’ The common opinion among residents is, ‘We voted for him three times, but he hasn’t done anything.’” <<> On Candidate Cho, Kim said, “Kim Yong-nam only looks at the residents of Pyeongtaek-eul, but Candidate Cho seems to only look at Kim Yong-nam. I don’t know why he’s so interested in me.” He continued, “When I announced a pledge to bring the Pyeongtaek West Police Station, Candidate Cho attacked me, saying it’s ‘already planned,’ but he confused it with the Pyeongtaek North Police Station. That just shows how little he knows about Pyeongtaek.” On the possibility of a pan-opposition unification with Candidate Cho, Kim stated, “There’s no justification.” He added, “It doesn’t align at all with the ‘centrist, pragmatic’ line pursued by the Lee Jae-myung administration and the Democratic Party. He still seems stuck in the 1980s (activist mindset).” <<> Candidate Kim said, “President Lee Jae-myung’s administration still has over four years left in its term. Residents will know which party’s candidate to elect as a lawmaker to scratch where it itches properly.” He pledged to push for the swift establishment of the KTX Southern Gyeonggi Station, accelerate the extension of the Shin Ansan Line, and publicize a circular public transit system, noting, “Pyeongtaek has a rapidly growing population, leading to overcrowded classes in elementary schools due to insufficient infrastructure.” (경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거에 출마한 더불어민주당 김용남 후보는 12일 이 지역 한 노인복지관에서 주민 한 사람 한 사람을 붙잡고 명함을 건네며 “평택은 어차피 1번이 됩니다. 복잡하게 따질 것 없이 1번!”이라고 했다. 큰절도 했다. 김 후보를 알아본 사람들은 ‘파이팅’을 외쳤다. 김 후보 측 관계자는 “매일 이런 일정을 하루에 10개까지 뛰고 있다”며 “절대 지지 않겠다는 뜻”이라고 했다. 김 후보는 이날 아침 출근길 인사도 했다. 목에는 이재명 대통령이 김 후보 손을 들어주는 사진이 붙은 팻말을 걸고 있었다.)

item.title: Jeon Jae-soo Emphasizes 'No Charges in Unification Church Case'... Park Hyung-joon Says, "Did the Cartier Fall from the Sky?" (전재수 ‘통일교 무혐의’ 강조에… 박형준 “까르띠에가 하늘에서 떨어졌나”)
item.description:
Jeon Jae-soo Emphasizes 'No Charges in Unification Church Case'... Park Hyung-joon Says, "Did the Cartier Fall from the Sky?" (전재수 ‘통일교 무혐의’ 강조에… 박형준 “까르띠에가 하늘에서 떨어졌나”)

In the June 3 Busan mayoral election, the controversy over the destruction of evidence by an aide regarding the 'alleged receipt of money and goods from the Unification Church' involving Democratic Party candidate Jeon Jae-soo has emerged as a key issue. On the 12th, the People Power Party launched a full-scale offensive, arguing that "it is impossible that candidate Jeon was unaware" of his aide smashing an office PC with a hammer just before a search and seizure by investigative authorities. People Power Party candidate Park Hyung-joon also pressed Jeon during their first TV debate, demanding, "Clearly answer whether you received it or not." <<> In the Busan MBC debate that day, Candidate Park stated, "The circumstances of the aide's evidence tampering are shocking," and added, "Not only did they smash the PC hard drive with a hammer, but they also discarded it in a field and a bathhouse. Could they have done all that freely without the lawmaker knowing?" He further asked, "Have you ever been to Cheonjeonggung Palace? Did you receive a Cartier watch? This is what our citizens are most curious about." <<> In response, Candidate Jeon said, "I am truly sorry and apologize for being at the center of this controversy," but added, "Please do not resort to negative campaigning to gain votes." He then emphasized that the police had decided not to press charges. Candidate Park retorted, "Then did the Cartier watch fall from the sky? How is it that your closest friend took that Cartier watch for repair?" To this, Jeon replied, "He is not my friend." <<> Pushed into a corner, Candidate Jeon countered regarding the Busan LCT apartment complex, which was embroiled in a preferential sales controversy and was once owned by Candidate Park's family: "You made a promise to the citizens and still haven't sold it, haven't you? And yet you're framing me as a liar." <<> The day before, the office of People Power Party lawmaker Joo Jin-woo released the indictment prepared by the joint prosecution and police investigation team regarding Candidate Jeon's aide. According to the indictment, Senior Secretary A instructed an intern secretary to reset all PCs in the Busan office in preparation for a search and seizure last December. After formatting, A smashed the PCs with a hammer and bent the SSDs by hand and foot. The damaged storage devices were then discarded in a field near the residence and a bathhouse. <<> The People Power Party also criticized Candidate Jeon at the central party level. Senior Spokesperson Choi Bo-yoon said in a commentary, "I am utterly appalled that crime concealment tactics typically seen in movies were executed in the office of a sitting Democratic Party lawmaker." (6·3 부산시장 선거에서 더불어민주당 전재수 후보의 ‘통일교 금품 수수 의혹’과 관련한 보좌진 증거 인멸 논란이 쟁점으로 떠올랐다. 국민의힘은 12일 전 후보 보좌진이 수사기관 압수수색 직전에 사무실 PC를 망치로 부순 것에 대해 “전 후보가 몰랐을 리 없다”며 총공세에 나섰다. 국민의힘 박형준 후보도 첫 TV 토론회에서 “받았는지 안 받았는지 명확하게 답을 하라”며 전 후보를 몰아붙였다.)

item.title: Prime Minister Kim: "Broad upward pressure on prices... Urge price stabilization measures" (金총리 “물가 전반 상승 압력… 가격 안정화 대책 강구하라”)
item.description:
Prime Minister Kim Min-seok stated on the 13th, "There is upward pressure on overall prices," adding, "This is a situation where the government must dedicate all efforts to managing prices." (김민석 국무총리는 13일 “물가 전반에 상승 압력이 가해지고 있다”며 “정부가 물가 관리에 전력을 다해야 할 상황”이라고 말했다.)

Kim made these remarks while chairing an emergency economic control meeting at the Government Complex Seoul on the morning of the same day. (김 총리는 이날 오전 정부서울청사에서 비상경제본부 회의를 주재하며 이같이 말했다.)

Kim first said, "It is truly fortunate that the current account surplus for March reached a record monthly high of $37.3 billion, and the GDP for the first quarter also grew by 1.7% year-on-year, maintaining a solid growth trajectory." He added, "Thanks to the government's efforts and the collaboration of the public and businesses, the supply and demand of key items such as crude oil and naphtha have remained relatively stable." (김 총리는 먼저 “3월 경상수지가 월간 기준 최대 규모인 373억 달러 흑자를 기록했고, 1분기 GDP(국내총생산)도 전년 동기 대비 1.7% 증가하는 등 견조한 성장세를 이어가고 있는 것은 참으로 다행스러운 일”이라고 했다. “정부가 노력하고 국민 여러분과 기업이 함께 협력해 원유, 나프타 등 주요 품목의 수급도 비교적 안정적으로 지속되고 있다”고 했다.)

However, Kim also noted, "It is still too early to be complacent, and this is a time when we must strive to secure additional supplies, such as through diversifying import sources." (김 총리는 그러면서도 “여전히 안심하기는 이르고, 수입선 다변화 등 추가 물량 확보에 노력을 펼쳐야 할 시기”라고 했다.)

Kim further stated, "With the rise in international prices of crude oil and other items, there is upward pressure on overall prices," and urged, "I ask that the Ministry of Economy and Finance and other relevant ministries closely monitor price trends for directly related items like petrochemical products, as well as agricultural, fishery, and food products closely tied to people's livelihoods, and devise price stabilization measures." (김 총리는 또 “원유 등의 국제 가격 상승에 따라 물가 전반에 상승 압력이 있다”며 “재정경제부를 비롯한 관계 부처는 석유화학 제품 등 직접 관련 있는 품목과, 국민 생활에 밀접한 농수산물과 식료품 등 여러 부분의 가격 동향을 면밀하게 점검하고, 가격 안정화 대책을 강구해 주기 바란다”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, Kim remarked, "In this situation, there are reports that citizens are enjoying domestic travel rather than overseas trips," adding, "When challenges arise, it seems not only difficulties emerge but also new circumstances and opportunities." He further noted, "We should also explore various efforts to ensure that the revitalization of 'K-tourism' becomes a sustained growth driver rather than a temporary phenomenon." (김 총리는 한편 “이 상황에서 국민들께서 해외여행이 아니라 국내 지방 여행을 즐긴다는 보도가 있다”며 “어려운 일들이 있을 때 어려운 일만 있는 것이 아니라, 새로운 상황과 기회가 생겨나는 측면이 나타나는 것 같다”고 했다. 그러면서 “‘K-관광’ 활성화가 일시적 현상이 아니라 하나의 성장 동력이 될 수 있도록, 다양한 방안의 노력도 강구해야 할 것 같다”고 했다.)

item.title: Government Already Sent Experts to Dubai to Investigate NAMU Ho... UAE Says "Drone Attack" (정부, 이미 두바이에 전문가 보내 나무호 조사했다… UAE는 “드론이 공격”)
item.description:
Government Already Sent Experts to Dubai to Investigate NAMU Ho... UAE Says "Drone Attack" (정부, 이미 두바이에 전문가 보내 나무호 조사했다… UAE는 “드론이 공격”)

Regarding the attack on the multi-purpose carrier 'NAMU Ho' operated by Korean shipping company HMM in the Strait of Hormuz, it was reported on the 12th that the government had already sent military experts specializing in drones and missiles to Dubai in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) to examine the debris of the aircraft discovered on the NAMU Ho. While there are observations that they may have largely determined the means of attack, the Korean government stated on the same day that it would bring the aircraft debris back to Korea and "investigate it through the Ministry of National Defense and others." Meanwhile, the UAE Ministry of Foreign Affairs, where the NAMU Ho is docked, issued a statement on the 11th (local time) criticizing the attack on the NAMU Ho as a "terrorist drone attack." <<> According to the office of Rep. Kang Dae-sik of the People Power Party, a member of the National Assembly's National Defense Committee, the Ministry of National Defense recently dispatched one drone expert and one missile expert from the Agency for Defense Development (ADD) to Dubai, where the NAMU Ho was towed, to inspect the damaged area of the ship and the debris of the aircraft. ADD is a weapons systems research institution that analyzed the debris recovered when a launch vehicle that North Korea claimed to be a "satellite" fell into the West Sea in May 2023. <<> Yang Uk, a research fellow at the Asan Institute for Policy Studies, also stated, "On-site inspection would have allowed for a significant understanding of the situation, and if it were Iranian-made weaponry, there would likely be more experts locally, so it's questionable why additional analysis is needed back in Korea." <<> However, the government announced that it would bring the aircraft debris into the country for a detailed inspection. Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul said on the same day, "The debris will arrive in Korea soon" and "The investigation will involve specialized institutes with relevant expertise that have been assigned to examine it." Deputy Spokesperson of the Ministry of National Defense, Lee Kyung-ho, added, "The government will support investigative activities." <<> Given that a hemispherical hole about 50 cm in diameter was found on the left stern plate of the NAMU Ho, experts are highly considering the possibility of a drone attack. Nevertheless, Minister Cho stated, "I have no knowledge of that" and "It's difficult to make a hasty judgment." Rep. Kang Dae-sik questioned, "Isn't the government delaying disclosure because it knows the means and perpetrators of the attack but is concerned about diplomatic repercussions?" <<> On the same day the Korean government emphasized a detailed investigation, the UAE Ministry of Foreign Affairs said, "We strongly condemn the terrorist drone attack targeting a cargo ship operated by a Korean company in the Strait of Hormuz" and called it "a serious threat to international navigation safety." It also stated, "The UAE expresses its solidarity with the brotherly nation of the Republic of Korea and offers full support for all measures to protect the security and safety of Korean ships and interests." (호르무즈 해협에서 벌어진 한국 해운사 HMM의 다목적 운반선 ‘나무(NAMU)호’ 피격과 관련해, 정부가 드론·미사일 관련 군 전문가를 아랍에미리트(UAE) 두바이에 보내 이미 나무호에서 발견된 비행체 잔해를 조사한 것으로 12일 전해졌다. 공격 수단 등에 대해 어느 정도 ‘가닥’을 잡았을 것이란 관측이 나오지만, 한국 정부는 이날도 비행체 잔해를 국내로 들여와 “국방부 등에서 조사할 것”이라고 밝혔다. 이런 가운데 나무호가 정박해 있는 UAE 외교부는 11일(현지 시각) 나무호에 대한 공격을 “테러리스트의 드론 공격”이라며 비판하는 성명을 발표했다.)

item.title: Chu Mi-ae: “Claims That ‘Fabricated Indictment’ Special Counsel Bill Unites Conservatives Is Manipulation” (추미애 “조작 기소 특검법에 보수 결집한다는 주장은 선동”)
item.description:
Gyeonggi Province Governor candidate Chu Mi-ae of the Democratic Party of Korea dismissed on the 13th the assertion that a special counsel bill targeting "fabricated indictments"—which would grant a special counsel the power to revoke indictments in cases related to President Lee Jae-myung—had galvanized conservative support ahead of the June 3 local elections, stating that "such manipulation must not be allowed." <<> Speaking on SBS Radio’s “Kim Tae-hyun’s Political Show” that morning, Chu responded to a host’s comment that reports suggested conservative forces were rallying in the Yeongnam region following the introduction of the fabricated indictment special counsel bill. She asserted, "In elections, one can find a hundred excuses if one wants to. The election should not be manipulated in this way." <<> Chu further argued, "The People Power Party, which fostered the insurrection, has consistently denied that the December 3 illegal martial law constituted an insurrection. The same applies to the fabricated indictment special counsel bill." <<> Addressing criticism of the bill, she said, "Opposing efforts to uncover fabricated indictments is merely an attempt to suppress justice." <<> She continued, "If the prosecution has abused its investigative and indictment powers for political purposes, the truth must be uncovered, and if investigations confirm wrongdoing, punishment must follow." She added, "If there are victims who have suffered unjustly, we must find ways to restore their honor." <<> Regarding internal calls within the Democratic Party to revise the special counsel bill, Chu noted, "As long as the principle holds that proper investigations into unjust indictments and abuse of prosecutorial power are conducted—revealing the truth and achieving victim recovery—the methods to achieve this can be flexibly adjusted." (더불어민주당 추미애 경기지사 후보는 13일 이재명 대통령 관련 사건의 공소를 취소할 권한을 특검에게 주는 ‘조작 기소’ 특검법안이 6·3 지방선거를 앞두고 보수 결집을 불러왔다는 주장을 “선동돼서는 안 된다”며 일축했다.)

item.title: Busan: Jeon Jae-soo 43%, Park Hyung-joon 41%; Daegu: Kim Boo-kyum 44%, Choo Kyung-ho 41% — Dead Heat [Gallup Korea] (부산 전재수 43% 박형준 41%, 대구 김부겸 44% 추경호 41% 초접전 [한국갤럽])
item.description:
A public opinion poll released on the 13th on the mayoral elections in Seoul, Busan, Daegu, and the Gyeongbuk governor race showed that the gap between ruling and opposition candidates has narrowed. In Busan, Daegu, and Gyeongnam, it's a tight race within the margin of error, and even in Seoul, the gap has significantly narrowed compared to a poll taken a month ago. (13일 공개된 서울·부산·대구시장과 경북지사 선거 여론조사 결과에서 여야 후보 간 격차가 줄어든 것으로 나타났다. 부산·대구·경남에서는 오차 범위 내 접전이 벌어지고 있고, 서울에서도 한 달 전 조사 때보다 격차가 크게 줄어들었다.)

◇Busan: Jeon Jae-soo 43%, Park Hyung-joon 41%… 11 percentage point gap from a month ago disappears (◇부산 전재수 43% 박형준 41%… 한 달 전 11%p 차 사라져)

According to a Busan mayoral election poll conducted by News1 and Gallup Korea on the 10th and 11th, 43% of respondents preferred Democratic Party candidate Jeon Jae-soo as Busan mayor, while 41% preferred People Power Party candidate Park Hyung-joon, which is within the margin of error (±3.5%p). In a hypothetical two-way matchup in a poll conducted by Gallup Korea for Segye Ilbo a month ago, Jeon had 51% and Park had 40%, a difference of 11 percentage points. (뉴스1·한국갤럽이 지난 10~11일 시행한 부산시장 선거 조사 결과에 따르면, 부산시장으로 더불어민주당 전재수 후보를 선호한다는 응답자는 43%, 국민의힘 박형준 후보를 선호한다는 응답자는 41%로, 오차 범위(±3.5%p) 안이었다. 한 달 전 세계일보 의뢰로 한국갤럽이 시행한 조사의 가상 양자 대결에서는 전 후보 51%, 박 후보 40%로 11%포인트(p) 차였다.)

By age group, Jeon significantly outpaced Park among those in their 40s (62% vs. 25%) and 50s (61% vs. 30%), but Park was ahead among those in their 70s or older (24% vs. 60%) and in their 60s (40% vs. 53%). Among those in their teens and 20s (29% vs. 35%), and those in their 30s (42% vs. 35%), the results were similar. Among conservatives, 64% preferred Park; among progressives, 78% preferred Jeon. Among moderates, Jeon received 47% and Park 34%. (응답자 연령별로 보면, 전 후보는 40대에서 62%대25%, 50대에서 61%대30%로 박 후보를 크게 앞섰으나, 70대 이상에서는 24%대60%, 60대에서도 40%대53%로 박 후보가 앞섰다. 10·20대에서는 29%대35%, 30대에서는 42%대35%로 비슷했다. 보수층은 64%가 박 후보, 진보층은 78%가 전 후보를 선호했고, 중도층에서는 전 후보 47%, 박 후보 34%였다.)

Regarding the special counsel bill for "fabricated indictments," 47% of respondents said it was 'inappropriate,' which was 17 percentage points higher than the 30% who said it was 'appropriate.' (조작 기소 특검법안에 대해서는 ‘적절하지 않다’는 응답자가 47%로, ‘적절하다’는 응답자 30%보다 17%p 많았다.)

On whether to empower the ruling party in the local elections, 43% said yes, compared to 41% who favored empowering the opposition, showing a similar split. (지방선거에서 여당에 힘을 실어줘야 한다는 응답자는 43%, 야당에 힘을 실어줘야 한다는 응답자는 41%로 비슷했다.)

◇Daegu: Kim Boo-kyum 44%, Choo Kyung-ho 41%… 'Fabricated indictment' special counsel bill deemed inappropriate by 54% (◇대구 김부겸 44% 추경호 41%… ‘조작 기소’ 특검법 부적절 54%)

In a Daegu mayoral election poll conducted by News1 and Gallup Korea on the 9th and 10th, Democratic Party candidate Kim Boo-kyum had 44% and People Power Party candidate Choo Kyung-ho had 41%, within the margin of error. In a hypothetical two-way matchup in the Segye Ilbo and Gallup Korea poll a month ago, Kim had 53% and Choo had 36%, a 17 percentage point difference. (뉴스1·한국갤럽이 9~10일 시행한 대구시장 선거 조사에서는 민주당 김부겸 후보가 44%, 국민의힘 추경호 후보가 41%로, 오차 범위 안이었다. 한 달 전 세계일보·한국갤럽 조사의 가상 양자 대결에서는 김 후보 53%, 추 후보 36%로 17%p 차였다.)

By age group, Kim significantly outperformed Choo among those in their 40s (70% vs. 22%) and 50s (61% vs. 33%). However, among those in their 70s (22% vs. 66%), teens and 20s (20% vs. 42%), and 60s (39% vs. 52%), Choo was well ahead of Kim. Among conservatives, 67% preferred Choo; among progressives, 80% preferred Kim. Among moderates, Kim had 55% and Choo had 27%. (응답자 연령별로 보면, 김 후보는 40대에서 70%대22%, 50대에서 61%대33%로 추 후보를 크게 앞섰다. 그러나 70대에서는 22%대66%, 10·20대에서는 20%대42%, 60대에서는 39%대52%로 추 후보가 김 후보를 크게 앞섰다. 보수층의 67%는 추 후보, 진보층의 80%는 김 후보를 선호했고, 중도층에서는 김 후보 55%, 추 후보 27%였다.)

Regarding the special counsel bill for "fabricated indictments," 54% said it was 'inappropriate,' which was 32 percentage points higher than the 22% who said it was 'appropriate.' (조작 기소 특검법안에 대해서는 ‘적절하지 않다’가 54%로, ‘적절하다’ 22%보다 32%p 많았다.)

On whether to empower the opposition in the local elections, 42% said yes, compared to 40% who favored empowering the ruling party, showing a similar split. (지방선거에서 야당에 힘을 실어줘야 한다는 응답자는 42%, 여당에 힘을 실어줘야 한다는 응답자는 40%로 비슷했다.)

◇Gyeongnam: Kim Kyung-soo 45%, Park Wan-soo 38%… Special counsel deemed inappropriate by 48% (◇경남 김경수 45% 박완수 38%… 특검 부적절 48%)

In a Gyeongnam governor election poll conducted by News1 and Gallup Korea on the 11th and 12th, Democratic Party candidate Kim Kyung-soo had 45% and candidate Park Wan-soo had 38%, within the margin of error. In a hypothetical two-way matchup in the Segye Ilbo and Gallup Korea poll a month ago, Kim had 44% and Park had 40%, also within the margin of error. (뉴스1·한국갤럽이 11~12일 시행한 경남지사 선거 조사에서는 민주당 김경수 후보가 45%, 박완수 후보가 38%로, 오차 범위 안이었다. 한 달 전 세계일보·한국갤럽 조사의 가상 양자 대결에서도 김 후보 44%, 박 후보 40%로 오차 범위 안이었다.)

By age group, Kim outpaced Park among those in their 50s (65% vs. 29%), 40s (58% vs. 24%), and 30s (39% vs. 30%). Among those in their 70s or older, Park led Kim with 23% vs. 59%. Among teens and 20s, it was 35% vs. 34%, a close race. (응답자 연령별로 보면, 김 후보는 50대에서 65%대29%, 40대에서 58%대24%, 30대에서 39%대30%로 박 후보를 앞섰다. 70대 이상에서는 23%대59%로 박 후보가 김 후보를 앞섰다. 10·20대에서는 35%대34%로 비슷했다.)

Regarding the special counsel bill for "fabricated indictments," 48% said it was 'inappropriate,' which was 19 percentage points higher than the 29% who said it was 'appropriate.' (조작 기소 특검법안에 대해서는 ‘적절하지 않다’가 48%로, ‘적절하다’ 29%보다 19%p 많았다.)

On whether to empower the ruling party in the local elections, 43% said yes, compared to 38% who favored empowering the opposition, showing a similar split. (지방선거에서 여당에 힘을 실어줘야 한다는 응답자는 43%, 야당에 힘을 실어줘야 한다는 응답자는 38%로 비슷했다.)

◇Seoul: Jung Won-oh 46%, Oh Se-hoon 38%… A month ago it was 52% vs. 37% (◇서울 정원오 46% 오세훈 38%… 한 달 전에는 52%대37%)

According to a Seoul mayoral election poll conducted by Gallup Korea for News1 on the 9th and 10th, 46% of respondents preferred Democratic Party candidate Jung Won-oh as Seoul mayor, 8 percentage points more than the 38% who preferred People Power Party candidate Oh Se-hoon. Reform Party candidate Kim Jung-chul, Justice Party candidate Kwon Young-guk, and Women's Party candidate Yoo Ji-hye each received 1%, 6% had no preferred candidate, and 7% said they didn't know or refused to answer. In the Segye Ilbo and Gallup Korea poll a month ago, a hypothetical two-way matchup gave Jung 52% and Oh 37%, a 15 percentage point gap. (뉴스1 의뢰로 여론조사 업체 한국갤럽이 지난 9~10일 시행한 서울시장 선거 조사에서는, 서울시장으로 더불어민주당 정원오 후보를 선호한다는 응답자는 46%로, 국민의힘 오세훈 후보를 선호한다는 응답자 38%보다 8%p 많았다. 개혁신당 김정철 후보, 정의당 권영국 후보, 여성의당 유지혜 후보를 선호하는 응답자가 각각 1%였고, 지지 후보가 없다는 응답자는 6%, 잘 모르겠다고 답하거나 응답을 거절한 사람은 7%였다. 한 달 전 세계일보·한국갤럽 조사에서는 가상 양자 대결에서 정 후보가 52%, 오 후보가 37%를 받아, 15%p 격차였다.)

By age group, Jung significantly outpaced Oh among those in their 50s (64% vs. 25%) and 40s (62% vs. 26%), while results were similar in their 60s (50% vs. 44%) and 30s (40% vs. 38%). Oh was ahead among those in their 70s or older, receiving 63% compared to Jung's 30%. Among teens and 20s (ages 18–29), Oh had 34% and Jung had 27%. Among conservatives, 70% preferred Oh and 21% preferred Jung; among progressives, 75% preferred Jung and 11% preferred Oh. Among moderates, Jung had 47% and Oh had 33%. (응답자 연령별로 보면, 정 후보는 50대에서 64%대25%, 40대에서 62%대26%로 오 후보를 크게 앞섰고, 60대에서 50%대44%, 30대에서 40%대38%로 비슷했다. 오 후보는 70대 이상에서 63%를 받아, 30%를 받은 정 후보를 앞섰다. 10·20대(18~29세)에서는 오 후보가 34%, 정 후보가 27%였다. 보수층은 70%가 오 후보, 21%가 정 후보를 선호했고, 진보층은 75%가 정 후보, 11%가 오 후보를 선호했다. 중도층은 정 후보 47%, 오 후보 33%였다.)

When asked which candidate would best implement real estate policies for Seoul, 34% cited Jung and 30% cited Oh, within the margin of error. Additionally, 43% positively evaluated the Lee Jae-myung administration's real estate policies, while 42% evaluated them negatively, also within the margin of error. Regarding whether the long-term holding special deduction, which reduces capital gains tax when selling a home, should be maintained for non-resident single-home owners, 35% said it should 'be maintained at the current level,' the highest response. Another 15% said the deduction rate should be 'increased,' meaning taxes should be further reduced. Responses for 'lowering the deduction rate' and 'abolishing it' were 16% and 14%, respectively. (서울시의 부동산 정책을 가장 잘 추진할 후보를 묻는 물음에는 정 후보라는 응답자가 34%, 오 후보 30%로, 오차 범위 안이었다. 이재명 정부 부동산 정책을 긍정적으로 평가한 응답자가 43%, 부정 평가한 응답자가 42%로, 역시 오차 범위 안이었다. 집을 팔 때 매기는 양도소득세를 깎아주는 장기보유특별공제를 비거주 1주택자에게도 유지해야 하는지와 관련한 물음에는 ‘현행 수준을 유지해야 한다’는 응답자가 35%로 가장 많았다. ‘현행보다 공제 비율을 높여야 한다’, 즉 세금을 더 깎아줘야 한다는 응답자도 15%에 달했다. ‘현행보다 공제 비율을 낮춰야 한다’거나 ‘폐지해야 한다’는 응답자는 각각 16%, 14%였다.)

Regarding the special counsel bill for "fabricated indictments," which would grant the special counsel the authority to dismiss indictments related to President Lee Jae-myung, 49% said it was 'inappropriate,' 18 percentage points higher than the 31% who said it was 'appropriate.' (특검에 이재명 대통령 관련 사건의 공소를 취소할 수 있는 권한을 주는 ‘조작 기소’ 특검법안에 대해서는 ‘적절하지 않다’는 응답자가 49%로, ‘적절하다’는 응답자 31%보다 18%p 많았다.)

In this local election, 48% said they should 'empower the ruling party for state affairs support,' which was 10 percentage points higher than the 38% who said they should 'empower the opposition for checks on the administration.' (이번 지방선거에서 ‘국정 지원을 위해 여당에 힘을 실어줘야 한다’는 응답자는 48%로, ‘정권 견제를 위해 야당에 힘을 실어줘야 한다’는 응답자 38%보다 10%p 많았다.)

The News1 and Gallup Korea polls were conducted via wireless telephone interviews, with a sampling error of ±3.5%p at a 95% confidence level. The Seoul mayoral poll targeted 802 individuals aged 18 and older living in Seoul on the 9th and 10th, with a response rate of 11.0%. The Busan mayoral poll targeted 801 individuals aged 18 and older living in Busan on the 10th and 11th, with a response rate of 14.7%. The Daegu mayoral poll targeted 803 individuals aged 18 and older living in Daegu on the 9th and 10th, with a response rate of 20.3%. The Gyeongnam governor poll targeted 804 individuals aged 18 and older living in Gyeongnam on the 11th and 12th, with a response rate of 13.4%. (뉴스1·한국갤럽 조사는 무선 전화 인터뷰 방식으로 진행했고, 표본 오차는 95% 신뢰 수준에서 3.5%p였다. 서울시장 선거 조사는 지난 9~10일 서울에 사는 18세 이상 802명을 대상으로 했고, 응답률은 11.0%였다. 부산시장 선거 조사는 지난 10~11일 부산에 사는 18세 이상 801명을 대상으로 했고, 응답률은 14.7%였다. 대구시장 선거 조사는 지난 9~10일 대구에 사는 18세 이상 803명을 대상으로 했고, 응답률은 20.3%였다. 경남지사 선거 조사는 지난 11~12일 경남에 사는 18세 이상 804명을 대상으로 했고, 응답률은 13.4%였다.)

The Segye Ilbo and Gallup Korea polls were also conducted via wireless telephone interviews, with a sampling error of ±3.5%p at a 95% confidence level. The Seoul mayoral poll targeted 803 individuals living in Seoul on the 10th and 11th of last month, with a response rate of 11.9%. The Busan mayoral poll targeted 805 individuals aged 18 and older living in Busan on the 9th and 10th of last month, with a response rate of 12.8%. The Daegu mayoral poll targeted 805 individuals living in Daegu on the 10th and 11th of last month, with a response rate of 13.9%. The Gyeongnam governor poll targeted 806 individuals living in Gyeongnam on the 7th and 8th of last month, with a response rate of 15.4%. (세계일보·한국갤럽 조사도 무선 전화 인터뷰 방식으로 진행했고, 표본 오차는 95% 신뢰 수준에서 3.5%p였다. 서울시장 선거 조사는 지난달 10~11일 서울에 사는 803명을 대상으로 했고, 응답률은 11.9%였다. 부산시장 선거 조사는 지난달 9~10일 부산에 사는 18세 이상 805명을 대상으로 했고, 응답률은 12.8%였다. 대구시장 선거 조사는 지난달 10~11일 대구에 사는 805명을 대상으로 했고, 응답률은 13.9%였다. 경남지사 선거 조사는 지난달 7~8일 경남에 사는 806명을 대상으로 했고, 응답률은 15.4%였다.)

For details on each poll, refer to the website of the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission. (각 조사의 자세한 사항은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 홈페이지를 참조하면 된다.)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae: "Local elections must purge the insurrection... The People Power Party is not qualified to contest the elections" (정청래 “지방선거로 내란 청산해야… 국힘은 선거 임할 자격 없어” )
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, said on the 13th, "The June 3 local elections are elections that will judge the December 3 martial law insurrection," adding, "The People Power Party will face the harsh judgment of public sentiment." (정청래 더불어민주당 대표는 13일 “6·3 지방선거는 12·3 비상계엄 내란을 심판하는 선거”라며 “국민의힘은 민심의 혹독한 심판을 받을 것”이라고 했다.)

Leader Jung made this statement during a press conference at the National Assembly that morning. He continued, "The war against the insurrection is not over yet," and "Yoon Suk Yeol, the mastermind of the insurrection, has only received a life sentence, while the People Power Party is openly carrying out 'Yoon Again nominations,' mocking the people." (정 대표는 이날 오전 국회에서 기자회견을 통해 이같이 밝혔다. 정 대표는 “내란과의 전쟁은 아직 끝나지 않았다”며 “내란 수괴 윤석열은 무기징역에 그쳤고, 국민의힘은 대놓고 ‘윤 어게인 공천’을 단행하면서 국민을 우롱하고 있다”고 했다.)

Leader Jung further stated, "Looking at the constitutional amendment bill scrapped due to the People Power Party's obstructionism, the insurrection is still ongoing," and "This amendment bill included provisions to clarify the procedures for declaring and lifting martial law. If the People Power Party had felt even a shred of responsibility, they would not have so outrageously scrapped this amendment bill." (정 대표는 이어 “국민의힘의 어깃장으로 폐기된 개헌안만 보아도 내란은 현재진행형”이라며 “이번 개헌안에는 계엄 선포와 해제 절차를 명확하게 하자는 내용이 담겨 있었다. 국민의힘이 일말의 책임감을 느꼈다면, 이번 개헌안을 그리 무도하게 폐기시키지는 않았을 것”이라고 했다.)

Leader Jung also added, "Furthermore, this amendment bill even included a new clause on balanced national development," and "Considering that local elections are conducted based on the values and philosophy of local autonomy, decentralization, and balanced national development, the People Power Party, which rejected the amendment bill, is not even qualified to participate in the June 3 local elections." (정 대표는 또 “심지어 이번 개헌안에는 국가 균형 발전에 대한 조문 신설도 있었다”며 “지방선거가 지방자치와 지방 분권, 국가 균형 발전의 가치와 철학을 토대로 실시되는 것임을 생각한다면, 개헌안을 거부한 국민의힘은 6·3 지방선거에 임할 자격조차 없다”고 했다.)

Leader Jung said, "I have continually warned that the People Power Party is an anti-constitutional, anti-democratic force that supports the insurrection and could be subject to a review for the dissolution of an unconstitutional political party," and "The People Power Party will face the harsh judgment of public sentiment in these local elections even before any review for party dissolution." (정 대표는 “저는 국민의힘이 내란을 옹호하는 반헌법·반민주 세력이며 위헌 정당 해산 심판의 대상이 될 수 있다는 경고를 끊임없이 해 왔다”며 “국민의힘은 정당 해산 심판 이전에 이번 지방선거에서 민심의 혹독한 심판을 받을 것”이라고 했다.)

Leader Jung concluded, "We must thoroughly judge the insurrection forces through the local elections and purge even the last traces of the insurrection," and "Through this, we must fully normalize the country and establish effective local governments to firmly support the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration." (정 대표는 “지방선거를 통해 내란 세력을 확실하게 심판하고, 내란의 티끌까지 청산해야 한다”며 “이를 통해 국가를 완전히 정상화하고 일 잘하는 지방정부를 세워 이재명 정부의 성공을 든든하게 뒷받침해야 한다”고 했다.)

item.title: [Breaking] People Power Party Selects Four-Term Lawmaker Park Deok-heum as Candidate for Vice National Assembly Speaker ([속보] 국민의힘, 후반기 국회부의장 후보로 4선 박덕흠 선출)
item.description:
On the 13th, the People Power Party selected four-term lawmaker Park Deok-heum (representing Boeun, Okcheon, Yeongdong, and Goesan districts) as its candidate for Vice Speaker of the National Assembly for the latter half of the session. Rep. Park also currently serves as the chair of the People Power Party's Nomination Management Committee. (국민의힘이 13일 국회 후반기 국회부의장 후보자로 4선 박덕흠(추욱 보은·옥천·영동·괴산) 의원을 선출했다. 박 의원은 현재 국민의힘 공천관리위원장도 맡고 있다.)

The People Power Party held a general meeting of lawmakers on this day and elected Rep. Park as its candidate for Vice National Assembly Speaker. The race for the party's Vice Speaker candidacy was a three-way contest among six-term lawmaker Cho Kyung-tae (representing Saha-eul, Busan), five-term lawmaker Jo Bae-sook (proportional representative), and Rep. Park. (국민의힘은 이날 의원 총회를 열고 박 의원을 국회부의장 후보로 선출했다. 국민의힘 국회부의장 후보는 6선 조경태(부산 사하을) 의원, 5선 조배숙(비례대표) 의원과 박 의원이 3파전을 벌였다.)

During the general meeting of lawmakers, a vote was held to select the candidate, and out of a total of 101 votes cast, Rep. Park received 59 votes and was chosen as the candidate. The National Assembly is expected to hold a plenary session to finalize Rep. Park's election as Vice Speaker of the National Assembly. <<>> (이날 의원 총회에서 후보 선출을 위한 의원들 투표가 이뤄졌고, 총 투표수 101표 중 박 의원이 59표를 받아 후보로 선출됐다. 국회는 본회의를 열어 박 의원을 국회부의장으로 최종 선출할 예정이다.)
